description.text: Deep darkness fills the frame. The

sits as a barely legible silhouette, a long, low mass with only the faintest cool highlights tracing its roofline and front edge. The surrounding space is almost black, with no clear horizon or ground detail beyond a soft charcoal texture that suggests asphalt. The paint is dark enough to absorb most of the light, so the vehicle reads first as a shape and only later as a body. At first it seems motionless, almost part of the darkness. Then it creeps forward, its outline thickening as it noses out of the black. The movement is slow and heavy, with a slight shift in the reflective sheen along the hood and fenders. A low engine rumble barely rises above hearing, felt as much as heard, while the cabin and wheels remain sunk in shadow. By the end of the shot, the car has separated from the background by degrees, becoming a readable shape without fully leaving the dark.
